text: Add the complete impression-time request-context feature group to the neutral additive user/video scaffold: tab, hour, and weekday encoded with train-only vocabularies and explicit unknown handling.
rationale: This is the highest-priority measured feature change: the training-only temporal screen found positive primary lift on every holdout day and full coverage. It can alter within-user ordering because context varies across impressions.
exact_ablation: Add only the request_context group consisting of tab, hour, and weekday; leave the additive architecture, BCE training, IDs, optimizer, and all other inputs unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Likely increase, approximately +0.001 to +0.003 relative to the seed implementation; the measured screen lift was +0.00221 in primary.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Small increase or near-flat result, approximately -0.001 to +0.002; the screen supports ranking value but does not establish a top-five-specific gain.
